tasks.behavior: Add a versioned diagram document schema with generated TypeScript types, runtime validation, and original architecture/workflow fixtures.
acceptance: A document schema version is stored and rejected when unsupported.
Generated types cover nodes, edges, groups, views, and layout hints.
Invalid documents fail validation with a structured error.
Original fixtures exist for nested groups, cycles, parallel edges, long labels, and disconnected components.

tasks.behavior: Implement a canonical scene graph for bounds, measured text, ports, edges, and groups that editor and export both consume.
acceptance: Scene output is determined by document, fonts, and layout options.
Text measurement supports multiline labels.
Ports are explicit and stable across a layout pass.

tasks.behavior: Run ELK layout in a worker with pins, nesting, cycles, and parallel edges, and surface constraint conflicts instead of dropping pins.
acceptance: Layout runs off the UI thread.
Pinned nodes keep position when space allows.
Insufficient space yields a visible conflict, not a silent pin drop.
Superseded worker results are discarded.

tasks.behavior: Export JSON, SVG, PNG, and offline HTML from the canonical scene with bounded raster size and no editor-only data.
acceptance: Exports are generated from the scene, not a DOM screenshot.
HTML opens offline without remote assets or credentials.
Oversized PNG fails with a smaller-size option.
Secrets, comments, and selection do not appear in the artifact.

tasks.behavior: Ship an original visual specimen in a running app: toolbar, outline row, node, relation, tooltip, command menu, inspector, and one interactive architecture diagram.
acceptance: Dark and light themes render the specimen.
The diagram uses original nodes and edges, not library defaults as the finished look.
390px and 1440px layouts remain usable.
Reduced-motion preferences disable non-essential motion.

tasks.behavior: Build the editor shell with a compact top bar, dominant canvas, collapsible outline, and command menu. Chat is collapsed by default.
acceptance: Title, save state, undo/redo, Present, and Export are reachable without chat.
Cmd/Ctrl+K opens the command menu and is ignored while typing in an input.
Inspector appears only for a selected element.

tasks.behavior: Support direct label edits, connections, rename, delete, duplicate, regroup, align, move, and undo/redo without rearranging unrelated nodes on a label change.
acceptance: Double-click edits a label.
A connection has explicit direction and meaning.
Undo restores the previous document.
A rejected edit leaves the last valid document in place.

tasks.behavior: Preview automatic arrangement before applying it, and keep pinned nodes unless a conflict is shown.
acceptance: Arrange diagram shows a preview and Apply/Discard.
Keep position pins survive a successful arrange.
Conflicts are visible when pins cannot be honored.

tasks.behavior: Autosave locally in IndexedDB with Saved/Saving/Recovery states and a downloadable backup when persistence fails.
acceptance: Reload restores the last saved document without an account.
Save state is visible in the top bar.
A storage failure offers a JSON download.

tasks.behavior: Prove the offline loop: create, edit, reload, and export without network or fake actions.
acceptance: An example can be edited and exported with the network disabled.
Reload after edit restores the same document ids and meaning.
No control claims a capability it does not have.

tasks.behavior: Land on an example-backed creation surface with three original examples and Import. Generation is disabled until a provider is configured.
acceptance: Examples load and edit without model credentials.
Submit shows interpreting / arranging / checking and can be cancelled.
A first-run failure returns the entered text and a repair action.
Sample content is never labelled as generated output.

tasks.behavior: Ship a CLI that validates, renders, and exports a document using the same schema and scene as the editor.
acceptance: Invalid input exits non-zero with a structured diagnostic.
Render and export match the canonical scene for a fixture.
The CLI works without the editor installed as a GUI.

tasks.behavior: Ship a small read-only viewer that shows a document from the same canonical scene as export, without editor chrome.
acceptance: Viewer HTML contains the same node labels as the SVG export.
The view has no edit controls, chat, or inspector.
The viewer package works without the editor installed as a GUI.

tasks.behavior: Add an original 100-node architecture fixture and prove validate, scene, layout, export, and CLI still work on it.
acceptance: The fixture has 100 nodes, validates, and is original.
Scene, layout, and SVG export succeed for the fixture.
The CLI validates the fixture without the editor.

tasks.behavior: R1.1 Portable layout and export parity: positions and pins travel with JSON, backup, import, CLI, and SVG/PNG/HTML.
acceptance: Move, pin, arrange, apply, rename, then export JSON/SVG/PNG/HTML and reimport; IDs, labels, groups, positions, and routes stay consistent.
Negative coordinates and nested groups round-trip.
Backup after a storage failure restores the arrangement.
Export uses the committed layout, not an arrange preview.

tasks.behavior: R1.2 One geometry pipeline: editor and export share scene dimensions, routes, arrows, and font-backed text metrics.
acceptance: Visual comparisons across fixtures at both themes: no clipped text, coincident parallel labels, or false arrows.
Canonical routes govern the editor; direction none/forward/both is visible.
Browser and Node text measurement agree for long, multiline, Cyrillic, and CJK labels.

tasks.behavior: R1.3 Safe editing: one selection model, layout results bound to document and layout revisions, presentation is read-only.
acceptance: Arrange then edit/undo/open another file cannot apply a stale layout.
Presentation mode ignores delete, duplicate, undo, and connect.
Failed operations leave the last valid snapshot intact.

tasks.behavior: R1.4 Durable storage and safe CLI writes: document library, honest save states, atomic file replace, numeric JSON is invalid.
acceptance: Two diagrams can be edited and reopened independently.
Unavailable storage never claims Saved.
Disk-write failure preserves the previous artifact; validate 0 fails.

tasks.behavior: R2.1 Real creation: blank diagram, open file, examples, recent, add palette; agent path instead of fake generation.
acceptance: A new user can build Browser, API, Database, group, pin, undo, reopen, and export without writing JSON.

tasks.behavior: R2.2 Useful editing: context menus, search, nested outline, fit/zoom, export dialog, browser PNG.
acceptance: Export dialog covers SVG, PNG, HTML, and JSON with theme and errors.
Search and outline can focus a node; keep-position is labeled as arrange-only.

tasks.behavior: R2.3 Offline viewer with pan/zoom/search/theme, bundled assets, no editor chrome.
acceptance: Downloaded HTML opens without a server; search and fit work; evidence is redacted.

tasks.behavior: R3.1 Publishable CLI: bundled binary, help/version/doctor, studio on loopback, tarball install in CI.
acceptance: Install a packed tarball in an empty directory and run help, validate, render, PNG, HTML, and studio.

tasks.behavior: R3.2 Companion agent skill that emits JSON or operations and calls the CLI; no guessed pixel positions.
acceptance: A clean agent install can generate a 10-node map, refine one node without destroying layout, and deliver offline HTML.

tasks.behavior: R4 Visual and performance finish: original chrome, measured budgets, lazy ELK, versioned offline cache.
acceptance: Toolbar does not overflow at 390px. Performance results include device, fixture, warm/cold, p50/p95.

tasks.behavior: R5 external evidence: five unassisted users and physical-device browser smoke. Automated crash, studio, skill, export, and visual checks live in F026–F031.
acceptance: Five target users complete create → export unassisted.
Desktop Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and a real touch-device smoke test are recorded.
tasks.blockedReason: Five unassisted users and physical-device smoke cannot be completed here. Automated product bugs are tracked as F026–F031 and must not wait on this evidence.

tasks.behavior: P0.1 Stop the editor Maximum update depth crash. Stable selection, node identity reuse, recoverable error boundary.
acceptance: Production-browser tests open a blank document and every example without uncaught page errors.
Select, deselect, box-select, shift-select, drag, undo, inspector, open another document, and reload do not loop.
A crash shows Return to library and optional Download recovery file without erasing persisted data.

tasks.behavior: P0.2 Protect Studio writes and document ownership: validate before write, unique temps, revision/hash, explicit Save, IndexedDB migration.
acceptance: Invalid primitive or object input leaves the Studio file byte-identical.
Opening a new diagram does not autosave into the previously opened file.
A previous-version local record migrates and remains recoverable.

tasks.behavior: P0.3 Repair skill and distribution: Codex agent flag, schema inside the skill, layout CLI, fail pack without editor assets.
acceptance: A packed tarball plus skill install in an empty project generates an 8–12 node map without authored coordinates and exports interactive HTML.
Onboarding does not advertise an unpublished npm version.
Renaming one component preserves IDs and manual layout.

tasks.behavior: P0.4 Canonical captions, browser PNG, shared interactive viewer, real fit/zoom/theme.
acceptance: A labeled branching map matches in editor, SVG, PNG, and interactive HTML.
Fit contains the map at 390/768/1280/1440px; both themes recolor the diagram.
Downloaded HTML works without a server.

tasks.behavior: P1 Coherent interface: shared primitives including a custom Select, layout spec, diagram component system.
acceptance: Native unstyled selects are not used in outline, inspector, toolbar, or export.
Toolbar, outline, inspector, library, and export follow the layout specification at 390/768/1024/1280/1440px.

tasks.behavior: P2 Interaction-path performance: indexed lookups, cached measures, precache manifest, browser interaction benchmarks.
acceptance: Selection and typing p95 are measured in the browser on 10/100-node fixtures with device and warm/cold recorded.
Offline first session includes the ELK worker before Arrange.
